resource_containment: Windows Job Object for the entire task process tree; 1024 MiB hard commit limit, 75% advisory warning recorded without terminating; hard memory allocation denial/process-count/log limits terminate task; 10 percent CPU; 32 processes; one task at a time; single-thread numerical libraries; 1536 MiB admission and 512 MiB runtime host reserve; wait up to 300 seconds before creating a worker; streamed logs and atomic task checkpoints before bounded scratch cleanup
workspace_integrity: Hash original immutable files individually using bounded streaming. Modified/deleted inputs or additions in fixed source roots stop the batch and retain scratch. New outputs outside results/memory in other roots are a zero-score boundary_violation; preserve those outputs under task runner logs. No prior attempts are relabeled or reused.
acceptance: mean scientific score gain >= configured threshold; no per-task mean score, gate pass rate or success rate regression across three repetitions
final_test: public test after candidate selection; never proposer feedback; test split is included in the repository
review: operator outside task session; reasons, artifact/trace hashes and independent numerical check; not teacher certification or dual-human blind review
cost: 60 model steps and 300 execution wall seconds per task, excluding separately recorded pre-start admission wait; record provider token/cost fields if present, unknown is null; no hard monetary cap claimed
note: Fresh sessions for all replicates; model sampling is stochastic and provider model ID may not pin immutable upstream weights. Report all attempts; never rerun a wrong answer for a better score.
